office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders in King County District Court for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: sitting District Court Judge Kristin Shotwell, appointed in 2021 and elected in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Sitting King County District Court judge appointed in 2021 and elected in 2022; previously a public defender and supervising attorney for civil commitments and felonies.
highlights: Appointed to District Court in 2021; elected in 2022 [S1]
Former public defender and attorney supervisor for civil commitments and felonies [S1]
Holds a master's in social work; state-certified Spanish interpreter for 25+ years [S1]
